correctness.rationale: For all n>=2 and real 0<=t<=n, reconstruct vertices of [0,1]^n with sum<=t: binary weights j<=m and m ones plus a single fractional delta, then maximize strictly convex squared-distance envelope at symmetric center. For 2m<n, the two quadratic branches meet at c=delta/2 and are minimized at m/n and (m+delta)/n respectively, so c=median(m/n,delta/2,(m+delta)/n); for 2m>=n the unique center is 1/2 with R^2=n/4. Contact orbits and plateau delta<=2m/n follow from strict inequalities in the envelope. Independent Fraction arithmetic rebuilt vertex inequalities and contact convex-hull orbit means for 272 (n,t) samples, including n=8,m=2 branch values; samples corroborate but do not prove the all-dimensional result. Singleton t=0, integer caps, transition ties and t=n checked conceptually.
